operatorScope: Only exact selected source-unit/fragment paint. Source timing, font, style, operator and all other layers unchanged. Not forced direction.
counterfactual: Call the original draw callback and preserve its geometry result, current path and post-call Canvas state; OFF applies an empty Path2D clip only during target paint. Cloned cut objects resolved by a unique stable index/line/start/end/source-text tuple; ambiguous identities rejected.
actualSourceFrames: Capture canvas data only when the real VideoFrame constructor submits that rendered canvas to the original encoder. All output frame clocks/RGBA hashes for ON and ON_REPEAT must exactly match the original selected shipping artifact. No deduplication or pixel tolerance.
nativeWindow: Full target fragment with one actual output frame before/after, clamped to actual output range. Store raw RGBA + actual native time, actual submitted timestamp and SHA256. Missing pre-entry frames remain missing.
analysisPolicy: This collector is diagnostic and always leaves encoded semantic realization UNMEASURED until an independently validated target-layer decoder analysis is executed.
Actual decoded ON/OFF/ON_REPEAT frames and original-vs-ON noise must be distinguished. No Native masks alone can certify encoded motion.

Any later reveal growth analysis retains existing >.02 native growth, >=.9 realization and >=3 actual frame requirements. Per-frame timing and independent target ownership must also be validated; do not tune against these outcomes.
Partial planned wipes and hidden source glyphs are not automatically missing lyrics; source/hold safety remains the original hash-bound FAV domain.
Different original/control PCM must be reported as visual-only. Isolated control modes themselves use the same audio object/plan/profile.

counterexamplesBeforeCollection.initialPortableTestFailure: Node Canvas returns color name blue rather than normalized #0000ff. Corrected the test to compare the actual post-set value; no production or sensor threshold change.
